name: Reporting & Analytics
summary: Dashboards, digests, and alerts that show leaders what is happening without anyone building a report.
description: Most small business reporting is a person copying numbers from four systems into a spreadsheet every Monday. It is slow, it is error-prone, and by the time it is finished, it is already out of date. These automations pull the numbers together on a schedule, deliver digests to the people who need them, and send alerts when a metric moves outside its normal range, so problems surface while there is still time to act.
